subject: Decision Making
title: AI in Medical Diagnosis
description: A quick win: understand AI in Medical Diagnosis.

hook.text: Google's AI detected breast cancer from mammograms with 11% fewer false negatives than human radiologists.

buildup.text: AI scans thousands of images in minutes. It never gets tired, distracted, or emotional.

discovery.text: But AI fails on edge cases. A rare condition not well represented in training data gets misclassified.

twist.text: The best results combine AI and human judgment. AI flags suspicious cases without replacing doctor review.

climax.text: AI alone missed context. Humans alone missed patterns. Together they outperformed both. Augmentation beats replacement.

punchline.text: AI spots what doctors miss. Doctors catch what AI cannot. Together they win.

quiz.question: Why does combining AI and human doctors work best?
options: AI catches patterns humans miss and humans provide context AI lacks
